fields.name: virtual_currency_transmission_covered
fields.description: Whether the license requirement explicitly extends to transmission of virtual currency in addition to fiat money.
fields.sample_quote: Engage in the business of transmitting virtual currency by means of a transmittal instrument for a fee or other consideration with or on behalf of an individual without first having obtained a license from the department.

fields.name: tangible_net_worth_minimum_usd
fields.description: Minimum tangible net worth in US dollars that an applicant must demonstrate, as determined by audited financials under GAAP.
fields.sample_quote: have a tangible net worth of at least five hundred thousand dollars ($500,000) as determined by audited financials prepared in accordance with United States generally accepted accounting principles

fields.name: surety_bond_amount_usd
fields.description: Required surety bond amount in US dollars that must accompany a license application.
fields.sample_quote: a bond in the penal sum of one million dollars ($1,000,000) executed by a surety company authorized to transact business within the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania

fields.name: application_fee_usd
fields.description: Non-refundable application fee in US dollars required to accompany a new license application.
fields.sample_quote: an application fee of five thousand dollars ($5,000)

fields.name: renewal_fee_usd
fields.description: Fee in US dollars required to renew an existing license.
fields.sample_quote: the license shall be renewed upon the payment of the renewal fee of five thousand dollars ($5,000)

fields.name: audited_financials_required
fields.description: Whether the applicant must submit audited financial statements prepared under GAAP.
fields.sample_quote: a financial statement showing a tangible net worth of at least five hundred thousand dollars ($500,000) as determined by audited financials prepared in accordance with United States generally accepted accounting principles

fields.name: agent_registration_required
fields.description: Whether a licensee must register all agents who conduct money or virtual currency transmission on its behalf.
fields.sample_quote: Register all of its agents who engage in the business of money transmission or virtual currency transmission involving individuals who are located in this Commonwealth.

fields.name: agent_written_agreement_required
fields.description: Whether agents must be appointed under a written agreement with the licensee specifying control, liability, and scope.
fields.sample_quote: An agent engaged in the business of money transmission or virtual currency transmission under subsection (a) or subject to an exemption under section 3 shall be appointed pursuant to a written agreement between the agent and the person on whose behalf the agent is acting.

fields.name: licensee_liable_for_agent_transmittals
fields.description: Whether the licensee bears full financial liability for transmittal instruments issued through agents.
fields.sample_quote: Every licensee shall be liable for the payment of all moneys or virtual currency covered by transmittal instruments which he issues in this Commonwealth whether directly or through an agent

fields.name: exempted_entity_types
fields.description: Categories of entities or persons explicitly exempt from the license requirement.
fields.sample_quote: Banks, bank and trust companies, credit unions, savings banks and trust companies organized under the laws of this Commonwealth; similar banking institutions organized under the laws of the United States or of any other state

fields.name: self_hosted_wallet_exemption
fields.description: Whether use of a self-hosted (non-custodial) wallet is explicitly exempt from the license requirement, subject to conditions.
fields.sample_quote: The use of a self-hosted wallet, unless the individual with control of the controllable electronic records in the self-hosted wallet transmits virtual currency as part of a third-party service on behalf of another individual in exchange for a fee or other consideration

fields.name: transmittal_instrument_name_display_required
fields.description: Whether every transmittal instrument sold must clearly display the licensee's name.
fields.sample_quote: Every transmittal instrument sold by a licensee directly or through an agent shall bear the name of the licensee clearly imprinted thereon.

fields.name: material_change_notice_days
fields.description: Number of days within which a licensee must notify the regulator of material changes in status such as address, ownership, or officers.
fields.sample_quote: Provide the department with written notice within ten days of any change in status, including address, ownership, directors, officers, contact information and the reason for the change.

fields.name: late_report_penalty_per_day_usd
fields.description: Daily monetary penalty in US dollars assessed for each day a required periodic report is filed late.
fields.sample_quote: Licensees who fail to file the required report by the date required by the department may be subject to a penalty of one hundred dollars ($100) for each day after the due date until the report is filed.

fields.name: criminal_penalty_classification
fields.description: Criminal classification of violations of the money transmission statute.
fields.sample_quote: Any person who directly or through another violates or attempts to violate any provision of this act shall be guilty of a felony

fields.name: criminal_fine_range_usd
fields.description: Statutory range of criminal fines (minimum and maximum) for violations of the act.
fields.sample_quote: shall be fined not less than five thousand dollars ($5,000), nor more than fifty thousand dollars ($50,000)

fields.name: administrative_fine_per_offense_usd
fields.description: Maximum administrative fine per offense that the regulator may levy against a licensee or associated person.
fields.sample_quote: any director, officer, employee or agent of any such person, who shall violate the provisions of this act or shall direct or consent to such violations shall be subject to a fine levied by the department of up to ten thousand dollars ($10,000) for each offense
